review:
Gems and coins on a pay-on-line grid, with three diamond chests hanging above the reels. Collectors sweep up coin values below.

Three diamond-triggered bonus games are on offer, and if two or more trigger at once they combine into one bigger bonus. The main draw is how often stuff happens – the bonus comes round roughly once every 36 spins on average. Medium-low volatility, a 3,000x cap and 96% RTP. A good one if you hate waiting for features. Follows on from Jewel Boom Super Drop.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 36 spins on average)
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
